description: Unchanged original relay framing tests; complete executed import closure independently read.

testEvidenceBoundary: Framing round trips, payload size/byte equality or in-memory decoder backpressure only, according to entry test. No live daemon handshake, SSH connection, full dispatcher, mobile, candidate, rendered, persistence or cross-version acceptance.
